results.title: RItrain-DIGIT to Train European Research Staff in HPC, Cloud and AI
results.description: Sept. 10, 2026 — A new European collaborative project, RItrain-DIGIT (Advancing Digital Competencies in European Research Infrastructures), has officially launched to bridge the digital skills gap within Europe’s Research Infrastructures (RIs). Funded under the European Union’s Horizon Europe program (Grant Agreement 101292852 / Call: HORIZON-INFRA-2025-01-DEV-01), the 1.5 million Euro initiative unites leading digital infrastructure providers and [...]

results.description: Four spy groups used BlueMoon to chain Chrome and Windows zero-days in one week, showing why fast patching and post-compromise hunting matter. The post 4 Spy Groups Used BlueMoon on Chrome, Windows in One Week appeared first on eSecurity Planet .
